results.evidence: tests/test_db_error_base.py asserts issubclass(db.MigrationError, db.DatabaseError) and that db.connect on a missing file raises db.DatabaseError (pytest.raises). db.py defines MigrationError(DatabaseError) at line 25. All 3 tests in the file pass under uv run --offline pytest. One caveat: the missing-file test uses pytest.raises(db.DatabaseError), which also accepts subclasses, so it does not prove the raised type is exactly DatabaseError. That matches the AC wording 'instance of db.DatabaseError'.
